hooks.text: 三类武器按顺序组合出六种攻击形态，再叠加18项专属天赋与百余件道具塑造构筑。
hooks.excerpt: Pinocchio wields 3 weapon types, which combine into 6 unique attack styles based on their order. Each style offers 3 exclusive talents—18 in total—that synergize with powerful Tarot abilities. Mix and match with 100+ items to create your own custom build!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 梦之卵既可激活也可吞噬，两种使用方式带来不同强化并允许战中调整构筑。
hooks.excerpt: Activate them in your inventory or devour them for completely different self-boosting effects. Manage them freely during play for highly flexible builds!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每张塔罗梦境都配置不同敌人、机制与挑战，要求同时运用策略、反应和观察。
hooks.excerpt: The Tarot Dream stages each offer unique challenges, enemies, and mechanics. Every Tarot card brings a distinct gameplay twist—where strategy, reflexes, and observation are key to victory.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
